en: A group for Sunday lunch with the family.
In Description, say what the group is for.
Add people: tick Mama Tobi and Bisi.
Tap Choose, then Make the group.
Each add is reported: one added, one invited.
Tap the group picture. Its info shows the name and purpose.
In the group, the tools button offers Order together.
